mxCell.value: CNP · Access matrix · what the segregation plan changes

One row per identity, one column per resource by access plane. A cell shows the level after the plan, and what the plan changed to get there.
Read a row: everything an identity can do. Read a column: who can touch a resource. A workload column touched by another project's identity is a leak.
Source: cnp-docs architecture/cnp. Not verified: the policy of the CMP's Vault token (drawn as the root token, the worst case) and the scope of its Cloudflare token (G15, G16). Plan phases: P1 root accounts, P2 CMP rights, P3 tenant isolation, P4 cloud accounts.
